blocks.html: This site collects no personal data of its own.

Visit requests

When you request a visit, the details you enter are sent to us by email and used only to arrange and confirm your visit.

Maps and fonts

Map tiles are loaded from CARTO and OpenStreetMap, and typefaces from Google Fonts. Your browser sends those services your IP address when it loads them.

Cookies

None. The site remembers in your browser session only that the loading screen has already been shown.
